notes.title: Bug Patch: Framerate Fix For Power Ups
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Bug Fix:[/b][/u][/h3]
There was some slight frame rate drop when players were getting the power ups. This update attempts to fix that issue.

notes.title: New Power Up Timer Bar and Bug Fix For Power Up!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]NEW[/b][/u][/h2]
A new power up timer bar has been implemented so players know when they power up is going to end.

[h3][u][b]Bug Fix[/b][/u][/h3] 
At level 10 there was a bug that the power ups were not working, so a fix was implemented for that.

notes.title: NEW FOX TROT POWER-UPS!
notes.content:
[h3][b]NEW FOX POWER-UPS![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884078/0cf203d7f83cb5006c6890ef293595085d7b3cf5.png[/img]

There are now boxes you can grab in game that will give you a random [b]power-up[/b]! ːsteamthumbsupː
This adds some more variety to Fox Trot, with more interactive gameplay! 

I hope you all enjoy the new update!
Happy running! ːsteamhappyː

Thank you,
-Lanceroy
